findings.title: A setup failure leaves Samantha looking on while she can never answer

findings.title: Some change list tests fail at random when the machine is busy
findings.summary: During full test runs a few change list and developer observability tests fail and then pass when run alone, so a busy machine can block a push for no real fault.
findings.impact: Pushes get held up and real failures are harder to tell apart from noise.
findings.done_when: Each of these tests passes reliably under load without proving less than before, shown by repeated runs while the full suite is busy.
findings.observed: 19 Nov 2026: ACU reinstall run full suite: test_bcl test_failed_command_does_not_overwrite_newer_plan failed twice. 16:47 IST #117 r2 presuite at load ~11: test_serve test_health_requires_matching_instance_tracker_and_pid, test_bcl test_fix_then_presuite_then_review_succeeds, dev-obs test_collector test_four_megabyte_jsonl_under_ten_seconds (10.2 s > 10 s); all passed alone and on rerun.
